# Delete account
{: .no_toc }

Request erasure: deactivate now, erase after 7 days.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ACC-08` |
| **Route** | `/account/privacy/delete` · deep link `substratal://account/privacy/delete` |
| **Where** | Personal › Account |
| **Who can use it** | Self |
| **Kind** | confirm |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwAlertDialog` (`extra-child` for fields) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| What happens | text |  | list: signed out everywhere; apps lose access; erased on {date}; support can cancel within 7 days | GtkLabel |
| Reason | text-area | body.reason | optional | GtkTextView in .card |
| Type DELETE | text-field | client only | must equal localized confirm word | AdwEntryRow |
| Delete account | destructive-button | POST /users/me/erasure-requests |  | GtkButton .destructive-action |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Delete account | `POST /users/me/erasure-requests` | 202 ErasureRequest → clear local data → AUTH-01 with "Your account is scheduled for deletion on {scheduled_for}." |

## Good to know

- If the User has an individual Standard subscription, warn first and link to "Manage billing" (BIL-03) — erasure doesn't cancel Stripe billing by itself (see OPEN-QUESTIONS).
